texts.content:
Only void. An intense white that does not reflect, emit, or wait. Suspended, black spheres drift trapped in a
constant pulse that expands, contracts, and repels, as if something inside were reaching outward.
Each one holds a passage: fragments, echoes, errors. There is no sign of origin or destination.

When you approach and touch them, they touch you back. Everything halts. The space around
seems to fold, as if the white were collapsing into itself.
They are arranged with ritual minimalism: nothing is excess, everything summons.

Those who descend through this rabbit hole find landscapes folding into themselves gardens
within gardens, buried constellations. Portals Garden does not promise
destinations; it offers keys. And each key opens new questions
